steps: Title screen: tapped Play a seed, typed HC-ARE-NOAH1, started as UAE (Hormuz Convoy)
Picked Guide me on the news question, Take office
Months 1-4 played (Desk months 1,2,4; Map months 3,4 order added from a country sheet)
Pressed the big button in month 4 without answering the crisis, got a quiet-month screen with approval -5
scenarios.notes: Seed code worked. Reached month 5 of 12. Did not start a second game: he had quit.

steps: Started in about 25 s with the seed box; first big moment (a summit picture and +10) came at the end of month 1, about 3 minutes in
scenarios.notes: Starting is fast, but it takes a lot of tapping before anything happens.

steps: Spy result screen (+25, PARTLY DONE) and the summit DONE stamp are screenshot-worthy; no share button seen

friction.expected: A box to type the code appears where I tapped
friction.happened: The box opened below the button, partly under the fold on a phone; I had to know to look down. Worked fine after that.

friction.where: Desk, every decision card heading ('Your call: your advisers disagree...')
friction.expected: A normal wide line of text
friction.happened: phone: the sentence is squeezed into a narrow column next to the How much? and Ask your staff buttons, ten short lines tall, pushing the answers off screen

friction.expected: See the crisis and its answers
friction.happened: phone: the goal box, the intro and the crisis picture fill the screen; the answers are two scrolls down, hidden behind a bar that says '3 more answers and Skip below'

friction.where: Month result screen, STEP ACHIEVED stamp
friction.happened: phone: the stamp sits on top of the month title and hides it

friction.expected: A close button I can reach
friction.happened: phone: the list opens as a long panel; the Close button is above the screen and scrolling would not bring it back; I only got out by tapping See all 9 again
phone: two-column dialog is wider than the screen, the answer text is cut off at the right edge, I could not read it
phone: the map is a small strip at the top (about 280 px), the crisis and big button sit under it. Tapping Saudi Arabia opened a clear sheet with Add buttons and a Why button; that part was good

friction.where: Results screen tabs (The month, Diplomacy, Home front)
friction.happened: phone: third tab cut off ('Hom'); only works if you notice you can swipe
Nine cards to go through (crisis, pact, mission, call from Xi, Saudi call, interview, orders). Too much for a 60 second patience; I skipped the Interview and Saudi call without reading

friction.where: Recommended orders card, Choose button when I had too little political capital
friction.expected: Something happens or I am told why
friction.happened: Tapped Choose twice on Reform program (costs 2, I had 1): nothing, no message. The reason only showed two screens later in Your own orders ('Needs 2, you have 1')

friction.expected: A big obvious button to move on
friction.happened: In Desk mode there is no Execute button until the last card; only 'Next'. In Map mode the big orange Execute is always there. I did not know that and went to Map to press it

friction.expected: More US jets at Al Dhafra (my first tap)
friction.happened: My own mis-tap picked the second card (Take the Iranian meeting); the review screen showed it clearly and I could have changed it. Not a game fault, but the two cards look the same

friction.where: Month 5 report after pressing Execute with the crisis unanswered
friction.expected: Something happened; I did a big move or nothing
friction.happened: 'A quiet month: the world moved on its own' with a plain black picture, while approval dropped 78 to 73 and a scandal is pending. Felt like it lied
The goal said above -90, the line says needs -90; with minus numbers I could not tell if -60 was good or bad
Five goals in one long sentence: no open war with Iran, Tehran door open, relations -90, 119 score, approval 80%. Did not read it
I chose Guide me, since I do not know most names. Clear and fast, took 5 seconds

friction.where: Names: Al Dhafra, Fujairah, Hormuz, IRGC, Mojtaba Khamenei, Abiy Ahmed, Mohammed bin Salman
friction.happened: Did not know any of them except Xi. Underlines and the i were there; I did not tap them

friction.where: Terms: pact, treaty, legitimacy, political capital (the diamond), Confidence at home, Intelligence on
friction.happened: Did not know legitimacy or political capital. The diamond number worked once I saw it go down, but nobody said what it was

friction.where: Month 2 Ethiopia pact offer, Decline card
friction.happened: Decline had an orange outline, so it looked like the pick, but the star was on Sign the treaty. Unsure what the orange meant

friction.where: Sudan crisis in month 2: 'See all' items marked Open
friction.happened: Open buttons and the cards both look pressable; the whole card did nothing different from the button

bugs.title: Choose on an unaffordable order does nothing and says nothing
steps: Open Recommended orders (1) card Reform program (2)
bugs.expected: A message that I need 2 and have 1, or a disabled button
bugs.actual: Nothing visible happens; reason only appears on the Your own orders card

bugs.title: Ask your staff dialog is cut off on a phone
bugs.actual: Right column runs off the screen; text truncated

bugs.title: See all list has no reachable Close on a phone
bugs.actual: Close scrolls out of view; list only closes by tapping See all again

bugs.title: Month report calls a month with -5 approval and a pending scandal 'quiet'
bugs.expected: Report names the scandal and what its default did
bugs.actual: 'A quiet month: the world moved on its own', black image; approval 78 to 73 in the details

bugs.title: STEP ACHIEVED stamp covers the month title on phone
steps: Finish month 2 on a 390 px screen

suggestions.what: Make the biggest button always visible in Desk mode as well, with Skip the rest as a first-class choice
Cap a month at 3 things for a new player and fold the rest into Staff decides
Let the result screen end with one shareable card (picture, number, one line)
Put the goal as five ticks with one short phrase each, not a sentence
Show the reason on the Choose button when it cannot be afforded
Phone: stack the call heading above the buttons, make Ask your staff a single column

delight: Seed box worked first time and the first screen after was ready to play
Summit picture with big green DONE and +10 (shots/noah-phone/012-r1.png)
Spy on Saudi Arabia: PARTLY DONE +25 intelligence, with the Crown Prince's angry quote (shots/noah-phone/036-r3.png)
Tapping a country on the map opens a sheet with Add buttons; Why on blocked orders (shots/noah-phone/033-map2.png)

fun.reason: The spy move and the summit were fun; the rest was reading cards.

clarity.reason: I could always find the next button, but I did not know what most words or diamonds meant.

visual.reason: The result pictures and stamps look good; the black picture in month 5 and the cut-off dialog do not.

feels_like_a_game.reason: The map sheet feels like a game; the Desk feels like a form.

agency.reason: Nothing stopped me except one silent Choose, but the month-5 report did not tell me what my choice did.

realism.reason: I could not judge much; the quotes from leaders felt real.

replay.reason: I would try another country if a friend dared me, not by myself.

recommend.reason: I would show friends the spy screen, but I would not say play it, too many steps.

quit_point: Month 5, right after the 'A quiet month' report with a black picture and approval down 5 after I pressed the big button and nothing I chose seemed to matter; before that, month 2 with nine things to go through nearly lost me.
verbatim: ok the spy thing was sick but why are there nine cards, I just want to press the big button and see something blow up
